stem: A cyclist travels $3.6\text{ km}$ in $12$ minutes.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Calculate the cyclist's average speed in $\text{m s}^{-1}$.

help.title: The formula
help.text: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. For an answer in m/s, which units must the distance and time be in?

stem: Which of these quantities is a vector?
markscheme: Velocity has both size and direction, so it is a vector.

help.title: Scalar or vector?
help.text: A **scalar** has only a size. A **vector** has a size **and** a direction.

help.title: Check each option
help.text: Which of the four tells you which way something is moving, not just how fast or how far?

help.title: Final answer
help.text: **Velocity** is speed in a given direction, so it is a vector. The answer is **C**.
